document.fictional_notice: FICTIONAL DEMONSTRATION RECORD — NOT A REGULATORY INSPECTION

inspection.basis: Quality agreement BPB-CAL-QA-2025 and supplier oversight procedure CAL-SQP-014
inspection.lead_inspector: Priya Nanduri, Director, Global Supplier Quality
inspectors: Priya Nanduri — Lead inspector, Global Supplier Quality

inspection.objective: Assess the site's investigation of the BP-1026-03 contamination event, determine whether the implicated transfer-path maintenance controls meet GMP and quality-agreement expectations, and evaluate whether containment and proposed corrective actions adequately protect Caldova product.
scope: Bioreactor suite BR-04 and associated transfer path to hold tank HT-04
Transfer connection TC-4, hose-set maintenance, assembly, and pressure-hold verification
Environmental and in-process microbiological monitoring for campaign BP-1026
Deviation, CAPA, training, change-control, and maintenance records relevant to the event
Supplier quality governance for contracted Caldova manufacturing
inspection.limitations: The inspection did not include unrelated suites, financial systems, clinical operations, or a full reinspection of all site GMP systems. Conclusions apply to the sampled systems and records.

site.address: 410 Harbor Point Parkway, Portsmouth, New Hampshire 03801, United States
site.operations: Mammalian cell-culture drug-substance manufacturing, harvest, intermediate hold, and bulk drug-substance storage
site.products_in_scope: Caldova campaign BP-1026; runs BP-1026-01, BP-1026-02, and BP-1026-03
site.previous_audit: Routine Caldova qualification audit, 14–16 April 2025; two minor observations closed 30 June 2025
site.licenses: Site-reported federal and state registrations reviewed; no independent regulatory certification is asserted by this fictional report

event_summary.immediate_action: Run isolated; transfer path and hold tank placed on quality hold.
event_summary.root_cause: A supplier-maintained transfer-hose connection was reassembled with a pinched gasket after preventive maintenance, compromising the closed path.
evidence: Positive sample localized downstream of transfer connection TC-4
Gasket inspection found a visible compression fold
Maintenance closeout omitted the required post-assembly pressure-hold result
event_summary.financial_reference: $111,000 contamination-investigation charge on invoice line INV-SUP-009-2026-Q4-L004; commercial disposition is handled separately

records_reviewed: Batch production records BP-1026-01 through BP-1026-03
Deviation DEV-BP-1026-SUPPLIER and supporting microbiology data
Work order WO-BPB-1026-441 and pressure-hold form PHT-BPB-1026-441
Transfer hose assembly SOP BPB-MNT-117, revision 6
Training matrices for BR-04 manufacturing and maintenance personnel
Environmental monitoring trends for BR-04, October–December 2026
Change controls and CAPA effectiveness checks sampled from 2026

system_findings.assessment: The site initiated deviation controls promptly and notified Caldova within the quality-agreement timeline. Investigation governance was weakened by late Quality involvement in maintenance evidence review and by an initial root-cause statement issued before the connection was disassembled.

Operators interviewed understood line clearance and aseptic response expectations. Two of six maintenance technicians had not completed the revision-6 practical assessment for sanitary gasket installation before performing independent work.

BR-04 was orderly and appropriately segregated. TC-4 is positioned below an overhead return bend, limiting direct visual confirmation of gasket seating after assembly. No inspection mirror or borescope step was specified.

Manufacturing records showed expected upstream controls and timely isolation. The closed transfer path was released to service without documented evidence that the required pressure-hold acceptance criterion had been met.

Microbiology methods, controls, and sample traceability reviewed were acceptable. Localization of the positive result downstream of TC-4 and the negative retained upstream sample were scientifically coherent with the identified breach.
The maintenance system permitted closure of WO-BPB-1026-441 while the linked pressure-hold result field was blank. The audit trail recorded the omission but did not trigger supervisory escalation.
Gasket receipt, storage, status labeling, cleaning, and personnel gowning controls sampled were acceptable. No evidence indicated incoming gasket material failure or deficient room sanitation.

The transfer path had an approved qualification basis, but maintenance verification was treated as a record-completion activity rather than a mandatory equipment-release gate. The control did not prevent use after incomplete testing.

No released Caldova material was implicated and no recall was initiated. Contract-notification controls operated as designed. The 2026 self-inspection sampled maintenance timeliness but did not test evidence completeness or release interlocks.

deficiencies.title: Closed transfer path released without required integrity-test evidence
deficiencies.statement: The site released transfer path TC-4 for manufacturing use after maintenance order WO-BPB-1026-441 although pressure-hold record PHT-BPB-1026-441 contained no result, reviewer confirmation, or objective evidence that the acceptance criterion was met.
deficiencies.evidence: Blank pressure-hold result; work-order closure audit trail; run BP-1026-03 equipment-release entry.
deficiencies.risk: Loss of closed-system integrity and microbial contamination of in-process product.

deficiencies.title: Maintenance qualification did not ensure reliable sanitary-gasket installation
deficiencies.statement: The practical qualification program did not prevent technicians without current revision-6 assessment from independently assembling product-contact connections, and the procedure lacked a compensating visual-verification method for TC-4's restricted orientation.
deficiencies.evidence: Training matrix sample; technician interviews; direct observation of TC-4 access; compressed gasket recovered from the connection.
deficiencies.risk: Recurring assembly defects may remain undetected until process monitoring identifies contamination.

deficiencies.title: Quality review entered too late in the maintenance evidence workflow
deficiencies.statement: Quality review occurred during deviation investigation rather than before post-maintenance equipment release for this high-risk product-contact connection.
deficiencies.risk: Incomplete evidence may not be challenged before manufacturing use.

deficiencies.title: Self-inspection sampling did not test maintenance-record completeness
deficiencies.statement: The 2026 self-inspection checked overdue work orders but did not sample mandatory linked test results or failed release conditions.
deficiencies.evidence: Self-inspection plan SIA-BPB-2026 and checklist review.
deficiencies.risk: Systemic record-completeness weaknesses may remain undetected.

classification_summary.overall: GMP compliance cannot be considered fully satisfactory for the inspected transfer-path controls until major deficiencies are corrected and effectiveness is verified.
classification_summary.supply_status: Conditional approval: no new Caldova BR-04 run may begin until interim controls for gasket verification, witnessed pressure-hold testing, and Quality release are documented and accepted by Caldova.

capa_plan.action: Revise equipment-release workflow so required pressure-hold results and Quality approval are hard-stop fields.
capa_plan.verification: Challenge test in validated maintenance system using a deliberately incomplete record

capa_plan.action: Replace TC-4 gasket and hose set; execute witnessed pressure-hold test before return to service.
capa_plan.verification: Approved protocol, raw pressure data, and Quality release

capa_plan.action: Retrain and practically reassess all technicians who assemble sanitary product-contact connections.
capa_plan.verification: Direct observation using seeded gasket-position defects

capa_plan.action: Add mirror or borescope confirmation and second-person verification for restricted-orientation connections.
capa_plan.verification: Three consecutive compliant assemblies at TC-4

capa_plan.action: Expand self-inspection sampling to linked evidence completeness and release-interlock effectiveness.
capa_plan.verification: Independent audit of 20 post-maintenance equipment releases
